info.title: BookingHub API
info.description: One bookable resource per tenant. Bearer credentials determine tenant identity. Bodies limited to 16 KiB. UTC timestamps require milliseconds. DELETE deactivates customers/services. Pagination includes inactive records. Rate limits are approximate, per Cloudflare location.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Filter booking start time; from inclusive, to exclusive. UTC with milliseconds.

parameters.description: Filter booking start time; from inclusive, to exclusive. UTC with milliseconds.
